'''2000 Manitoba Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship held in University of Manitoba, Winnipeg, Manitoba on 20 May 2000. [[Robert Dean]] won it. It is known from Robert Dean's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d817">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-28-winnipeg-manitoba-5-20-00d817/ winnipeg-manitoba-5-20-00], DeckTech (Robert "The Tick" Dean, 28 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-28-winnipeg-manitoba-5-20-00d817/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' University of Manitoba, Winnipeg, Manitoba
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Robert Dean]]
